title: data.pdf — section 302
text:
(4) Any power to make an order or regulations shall be exercisable by statutory
rule for the purposes of the Statutory Rules (Northern Ireland) Order 1979.

(5) No regulations shall be made under section 6A unless a draft of the
regulations has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, the
Northern Ireland Assembly.

(6) Regulations (other than regulations under section 6A) shall be subject to
negative resolution (within the meaning of section 41(6) of the Interpretation
Act (Northern Ireland) 1954).

(7) No order shall be made under section 25 unless a draft of the order has been
laid before, and approved by a resolution of, the Northern Ireland Assembly.

(8) Section 41(3) of the Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954 applies for
the purposes of subsections (5) and (7) in relation to the laying of a draft
as it applies in relation to the laying of a statutory document under an
enactment.”.]
